command.description: The program the connector starts instead of the default one, such as ccs.

args.description: Arguments placed before the ones the connector adds to start or resume the session.

environment.description: Extra environment variables for the program.

timeoutMilliseconds.description: How long one wake may run before the connector stops it.

agents.description: Overrides per connector client. Each key is a client id, and the fields of the entry replace the defaults.
